curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How will Michael’s Dorothy Michaels alter ego lead from a daytime-drama part to a romantic pickle?
curatedMovie.description: Out-of-work actor Michael Dorsey takes on the identity Dorothy Michaels to win a daytime-drama part, becoming a feminist icon.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A witty, thoughtful comedy with steady pacing and engaging romantic complications tailored for date night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Sydney Pollack directs a sharp, warm romantic comedy where a desperate career gamble spirals into sharp social reflection and genuine romantic chaos.
